text: Republic Act No. 12009, the New Government Procurement Act signed on July 20, 2024, expressly repealed which earlier law?
optionA: RA 6713, the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees
optionB: RA 9184, the Government Procurement Reform Act
optionC: RA 11032, the Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act

text: Which law signed in November 2024 declares the Philippines' internal waters, archipelagic waters, territorial sea, contiguous zone, exclusive economic zone, and continental shelf in line with UNCLOS?
optionA: Philippine Archipelagic Sea Lanes Act
optionB: Philippine Baselines Law
optionD: Philippine Fisheries Code, as amended

text: How many archipelagic sea lanes, with corresponding air routes, are designated by the Philippine Archipelagic Sea Lanes Act (RA 12065) of 2024?
optionA: Three
optionB: Two
optionD: Five

text: Under the Anti-Financial Account Scamming Act (AFASA) of 2024, a person who knowingly lets his or her bank or e-wallet account be used to receive and transfer proceeds of scams is punished as a:
optionA: Social engineering scheme operator
optionB: Mass mailer
optionD: Money mule

text: Republic Act No. 12023, signed on October 2, 2024, subjects digital services supplied by nonresident digital service providers (such as streaming platforms) and consumed in the Philippines to:
optionA: A 5% percentage tax on gross receipts
optionB: The 12% value-added tax
optionD: A 10% excise tax on digital content

optionA: Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers
optionB: Philippine Maritime Labor Act
optionD: Overseas Seafarers' Rights Act

Under the No Permit, No Exam Prohibition Act (RA 11984), a student's status as 'disadvantaged' must be certified by:

optionA: Guimaras

optionD: Antique

text: Under RA 12027, which lapsed into law in October 2024, the primary media of instruction from Kindergarten to Grade 3 generally revert to:
optionA: Filipino and English, with regional languages as auxiliary media

optionC: English only, to improve international test scores
optionD: The dominant regional language, with Filipino as auxiliary

optionA: Free tuition in state universities and colleges
optionB: An alternative learning system for out-of-school youth and adults
optionC: A national learning intervention and tutorial program for learners below minimum proficiency
optionD: A daily school-based feeding program for undernourished learners

optionA: National Artists and their surviving heirs
optionB: Professional athletes in national sports events
optionD: Workers in the movie and television industry

optionA: A P10,000 monthly salary increase
optionB: An annual teaching allowance raised to P10,000 and exempt from income tax
optionD: A one-time service recognition incentive every five years

text: Under the Civil Service Commission's 2025 Omnibus Rules on the Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN), which earlier requirement was removed from the SALN?
optionA: Filing of the SALN every year
optionB: Filing of the SALN upon assumption of office
optionC: The signature of the declarant's spouse
optionD: Disclosure of liabilities

optionA: Without a legislative franchise, subject to registration with the National Telecommunications Commission
optionB: Only after obtaining a congressional franchise and a CPCN
optionD: Under licenses issued by local government units instead of the NTC

optionA: Sets mandatory price ceilings on rice and vegetables
optionB: Creates a separate Department of Fisheries
optionC: Replaces rice import quotas with tariffs
optionD: Treats large-scale smuggling, hoarding, profiteering, and cartels of agricultural and fishery products as economic sabotage

text: The Anti-POGO Act of 2025 (RA 12312) repealed which law that had imposed taxes on offshore gaming operations?
optionA: RA 9487, extending the franchise of PAGCOR
optionC: RA 10927, covering casinos under the Anti-Money Laundering Act
optionD: RA 9287, increasing penalties for illegal numbers games

optionB: Department of the Interior and Local Government
optionC: Department of Social Welfare and Development

optionA: Department of Economy, Planning, and Development

optionD: Department of Economic Coordination and Development

optionD: ASEAN-inspired attire

text: The 2025 Rules on Administrative Cases in the Civil Service (2025 RACCS), promulgated by the CSC on April 30, 2025, replaced the:
optionA: 2017 Rules on Administrative Cases in the Civil Service

optionC: 2011 Revised Rules on Administrative Cases in the Civil Service
optionD: 2025 Omnibus Rules on Appointments and Other Human Resource Actions
